# Commissioning checklist: printer_v10_1

Generated by `tools/build_package.py` from `designs/printer_v10_1.py` (md5 `743760e5b9f33592d177b095466ca1b8`) and `out/printer_v10_1/report.json` (written 2026-11-19 04:43:46, md5 `b3480109e84b`). Do not edit: change the design, re-run verify, re-run the generator.

> **Simulated design. Nothing has been built.** See [OPEN_ITEMS.md](OPEN_ITEMS.md) before spending money.

Ordered: bench tests before assembly (B), mechanical checks with the power off (M), first power-up and calibration (E). Every step has what the simulation predicts and an acceptance range. **Write the measured value down in every row, pass or fail: this first build is the experiment that tests the digital twin.** `commissioning_record.csv` is the same table for filling in.

Predictions come from `report.json`, `scores.jsonl` (2026-11-19T05:56:42) and `tune/tuning.json`; none is typed here. Acceptance ranges that are not the twin's own range or a limit in the design are engineering judgement written in the generator and say so by their form (a +/- percentage).

> **MAINS VOLTAGE. This design has NOT been safety-certified, tested or inspected by anyone.** The mains side (inlet, fuse, relay module, supply terminals, protective earth) must be wired, or checked before first power, by a person competent to do so under your local rules. The electrical verifier checks ratings and that the wires exist; it does not check creepage, enclosure, strain relief, touch protection, or any standard.

Power the sensor from 24 V, watch its LED / output. | Lower the sensor square onto the sheet on a height gauge or a stack of feeler gauges; note the gap at which it switches on. Repeat at the centre, 12 mm from an edge and over a post head position. Cold (room temperature). | 5 mm nominal (OMRON's figure for a 1 mm iron target), 4.5 to 5.5 mm over unit spread | **PASS as designed: >= 2.86 mm** at every point (= (face height 2 + margin 0.57) / (1 - 0.1 temperature drift)).
